lead_raw_text:
The structure of Tm₄Ni₄O₁₂ (reduced formula TmNiO₃) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group P2₁/c (No. 14), with 20 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Ni centers as octahedrally coordinated by six O neighbors, while Tm centers show eight O neighbors; O centers have two Ni neighbors. The Ni octahedra share corners and edges with one another and with Tm polyhedra, and the periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component.
